//: HAND-AUTHORED (2026-10-30): the Psionic Alliance -- faction, NPCs and dialogue for the quarry enclave.  The map and the NPC placements are generated by tools/gen_psi_enclave.py; this file is NOT generated, edit it directly.
name: The Psionic Alliance
description: Awakened psions who found each other in the first weeks of the Cataclysm and dug in at a worked-out granite quarry.  They would rather be left alone, and mostly they are.

job_description: I keep nine frightened people alive and mostly sane.
I keep the forge lit.  Usually on purpose.
I build things out of rocks nobody else can lift.
I'm the sun, for a basement full of tomatoes.
I charge the batteries.  Every day.  By myself.
I watch the map.  Then I watch the world.
Supply runs.  Long ones.  Very fast.
I knit bone.  I used to do taxes.
I eat.  Then I lift things.  Then I eat.

//: The leader.  Three tiers: awakened in any school / Psychic Knacks only / not a psion.  u_has_var psi_alliance_met_leader is set by speaker_effect, which BN applies AFTER the line and responses are built (npctalk.cpp dialogue::opt), so the first-meeting branch shows exactly once.

yes: Welcome back.  Your mind's quieter than last time.  Good.
There you are.  Sit, if you like.  Nobody here will ask you to explain yourself.
Back again.  The quarry's glad of you, even if Eli won't say so.

no.yes: The one with the spark.  Still not a fire, I see.  Give it time.
no.no: You're back.  Still keeping your thoughts friendly, I hope.

no.yes: I heard you coming from the gate.  You think in capital letters, did you know that?  Don't worry.  Most of us did, at first.  I'm Constance.  Welcome to the Alliance.  You're safe here.
There's a spark in you.  Not a fire, not yet, but I can see it from across the room.  You're welcome to sit by ours.  I'm Constance.
no.no: You're not one of us.  That's all right; we aren't choosy about who we feed.  But understand where you're standing.  Everyone in this quarry can do something you can't, and most of them are tired.  Keep your hands to yourself and your thoughts friendly, and there won't be any trouble.  I'm Constance.

responses.text: How did you all find each other?
What's in the old magazine up on the rim?

dynamic_line: The Psionic Alliance.  It's a grander name than nine frightened people deserve, but it was Eli's idea and he'd sulk.  We all woke up in the first weeks.  Most of us touched a crystal; a couple of us still don't know what happened.  What we have in common is that nobody else understood it, and none of us wanted to go through it alone.

A granite quarry, worked out years before any of this.  We chose it because the pit is a wall nothing climbs, the stone is free, and it's quiet.  Quiet matters, when half of us can hear thinking.  The office was the quarry's.  Everything else we built: Marcus stacked the cabins, Dana lit the forge, and Priya grows tomatoes in the basement, which I still can't quite believe.

Wren found us.  When someone awakens, she feels it, like a match struck in a dark room.  She walked to the first two of us on foot.  Then Jules learned to jump, and things got faster.  We still look.  There's a wall in the map room full of pins, and every green one is somebody who woke up alone.

responses.text: What happens to the ones who wake up alone?

dynamic_line: Some of them figure it out.  Most of them don't, not in time.  You've seen them out there: the ones who set fields on fire, or scream at the sky with lightning on their skin.  That's what it looks like when you go through this with nobody to tell you that you aren't going mad.  So we try to get there first.

dynamic_line.yes: Of course.  There's a free bunk in the south cabins, the mess feeds whoever's here, and the forge is open.  One more thing.  If you ever start to hear a hum you can't place, go down to the pump house at the bottom of the pit and sit.  There are dampeners in the lockers.  Nobody will ask why.
dynamic_line.no: You can rest here.  Eat in the mess, sleep by the stove, use the forge.  Ask first, and don't take what isn't offered.  Two more rules: stay out of the pit, and stay away from the magazine on the rim.

dynamic_line: Crystals.  The thing that did this to us, in raw form.  That magazine used to hold blasting caps, and it's about the right amount of respect.  It's locked, there is no key, and that's the end of it.

Then you'd be the third person to ask this month, and the answer hasn't changed.  We've seen what those stones do to people who aren't ready.  Sometimes to people who are.  Please don't make me have this conversation a second time.

//: Shared: every follower points here until the player has met Constance.
dynamic_line: Constance.  The office at the end of the road; her room is through the map room.  She'll know you're coming before you knock.  Don't let it bother you.  It bothers everyone at first.

yes: The forge is lit.  It's always lit.  You're welcome to use it.
Mind the anvil, it's hot.  No, I didn't heat it.  Well.  Not on purpose.
dynamic_line.no: New face.  If you're looking for whoever's in charge, that's Constance, in the office up the road.  Go and see her before you touch anything.  Especially the forge.

responses.text: Why is the charcoal only for guests?

dynamic_line: Because I'm the charcoal.  A month ago that would've been a joke.  Now things catch fire when I get annoyed at them.  You've seen the shed out on the range?  That was a Tuesday.  I'm much better now.  Mostly.

yes: Need something moved?  Everything weighs about the same to me now.  Weird thing to know about yourself.
One more cabin and we can stop doubling up.  Well.  One more cabin and one more roof.
dynamic_line.no: *sets down a granite block the size of a footlocker without touching it.*  Hi.  You'll want Constance.  The office, up the road.

dynamic_line: Every cabin you see, I stacked.  The boulder wall too.  With a forklift it would have taken a month.  The trick isn't lifting them, it's setting them down gently enough that they don't crack.  I cracked a few learning that.  They're in the wall now.

yes: Tomatoes.  In a basement.  In autumn.  You're welcome.
Lights on at six, lights off at six.  Some people don't respect the schedule.
dynamic_line.no: Oh!  Hi.  Mind the planters.  If you're new, Constance will want to see you; she's upstairs, through the map room.

responses.text: How do plants grow down here?

dynamic_line: I'm the sun down here.  Twelve hours a day, every day.  It sounds peaceful until you've done it for a month.  The lamps help when I need to sleep, but plants can tell the difference.  So can I, honestly.  The light I make is warmer.

yes: Battery bank's at ninety percent.  You can thank me.  Everybody else forgets to.
If your flashlight's dead, leave it on the bench downstairs.  I'll get to it.  Eventually.
dynamic_line.no: Constance runs things.  Office, up the road.  And whatever you've heard about my bed, it works.

responses.text: So... about the cage around your bed.

dynamic_line: Go on, ask.  ...Fine.  I discharge in my sleep.  Little arcs, mostly.  The first week I cooked a radio, two phones and Theo's reading glasses, and I don't even know how that last one works.  So: chain-link all round the bed, grounded to a stake in the floor.  It's a Faraday cage.  It works.  Stop smiling.

yes: Every pin on that wall is something I saw without seeing it.
The hordes are moving east this week.  Not toward us.  Not yet.
dynamic_line.no: You came in through the gate and stopped twice to look back.  Sorry.  Habit.  Constance is through that door; she'll want to meet you.

responses.text: Is there a green pin I could follow up?

responses.//: Safety net: the loop normally renews itself through the mission's followup, but if it is ever broken (a mission failed and never reported, a save from before the quest existed) this hands out a fresh pin.
responses.text: Is anyone else out there who needs finding?

dynamic_line: People like us, the moment they woke up.  When someone awakens it's loud.  Not to the ears.  Like a flare going up over the trees.  I mark it, and we send someone, because the alternative is they figure it out alone.  We're always short of someone to send.

yes: Off the circle, please.  Thank you.  I'm due in Ohio by noon.
Brought back canned peaches from somewhere near Albany.  Don't tell Ray.
dynamic_line.no: Oh!  You're new.  Please don't stand in the circles.  If you're looking for someone in charge, Constance is in the office.

responses.text: What's wrong with standing in the circles?

dynamic_line: The scale's flat, it's clear, and it's steel, so it holds a picture well in my head.  When I come home, I aim for a circle.  If something is in the circle when I land...  Look.  Just don't be in the circle.

yes: Eleven days.  I'd like to make it twelve.  Try not to be the reason it isn't.
Sit, if you're bleeding.  Stand, if you're not.  The beds are for the bleeding.
dynamic_line.no: You're hurt, or you're new.  If you're new, Constance is next door, through the map room.  If you're hurt, sit down.  Either way, don't bleed on the floor.  I just mopped.

dynamic_line: I'm the closest thing.  I knit bone now.  Skin, muscle, the works.  Before all this I was an accountant.  The whiteboard was my idea.  It helps to count something that goes up.

yes: Third breakfast.  Don't judge.
Have you seen the board?  Check the board.
dynamic_line.no: *keeps eating.*  Boss is in the office.  Constance.  I'd walk you over, but I'm busy.

dynamic_line: Biokinetics burn it faster than you'd believe.  My body runs hot; it's rebuilding itself all day long.  Theo and I keep score.  I'm winning this week.  If Theo tells you he's winning, he's lying.  Check the board.

//: GREEN PIN -- the repeating fetch quest.  Wren offers it (mission_offered); `followup` names the mission itself, so turning one in (talk_function::clear_mission) queues the next.  Goal MGOAL_RECRUIT_NPC: done when the target NPC placed by update_mapgen (target:true) is the player's ally.  The end phase sets psi_alliance_recruit_delivered, which unlocks the recruit's 'settle in' line.
name: Green Pin
description: Wren felt someone awaken.  Find the new psion where she marked your map and bring them back to the quarry, before they have to figure it out alone.

dialogue.offer: There's a new green pin.  Someone awakened in the last day or so, and they're alone, and they're frightened.  I've marked where I felt them.  Will you go and bring them home?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  Be gentle.  Whatever they can do, they can't control it yet.
dialogue.rejected: That's all right.  Jules will go when he's back.  If he's back.
dialogue.advice: Don't startle them.  If you're one of us, let them feel it; that does more than talking ever will.  If you're not, talk slowly, and keep your hands where they can see them.
dialogue.success: You brought them.  I can feel them from here, quieter already.  Thank you.  That's one less person going through this alone.
dialogue.success_lie: No.  I'd feel them if they were here.  Go back.
dialogue.failure: I felt it when they went out.  Like a candle.  ...We'll get to the next one sooner.

//: The awakened recruit.  First contact (school-specific panic) -> persuade, or if the player is a psion, show them -> follow.  While following, once the mission has been turned in to Wren, 'settle in' makes them a camp resident.

yes: Is it much further?
Do they really all have it?  Whatever this is?
Sorry if I'm jumpy.  Everything is jumpy.
I keep waiting to wake up.  I don't think that's how this works.

no.yes: Don't look at my arm.  It was broken two hours ago.  It healed wrong.  No, it healed RIGHT, and that's worse.
I knew you were coming.  I watched you walk up the road an hour ago.  I wasn't there.  How was I not there?
Don't touch me.  I mean it.  The last person who touched me went down twitching, and I don't know how to make it stop.
&The air around them glows faintly, like a lamp left on in daylight.  "Make it stop.  Please.  They can see me coming from a mile away."
Stay back!  Everything I touch catches fire.  The grass, my jacket, the... just stay BACK!
&A road sign lies bent double beside them, and they are staring at it.  "I didn't touch that.  I swear I didn't touch it."
Stop thinking so loud.  Please.  Everyone, everything, it's all so LOUD.
Where am I?  I was in my kitchen.  I blinked and I was here.  Before that I was on a roof.  I can't stop doing it.
no.no: Who are you?  What do you want?

responses.text: *Let a little of your own power show.*  You're not the only one.  There's a place for people like us.
Wren sent me.  There are others like you, at a quarry not far from here.  They can help.

dynamic_line: ...Okay.  Okay.  If there's somewhere I can stop being scared of my own hands, I'll go.  Lead the way.
I don't know you.  I don't know anything anymore.  Just... give me some time.  Come back later.
*looks around the quarry, at the stone cabins and the smoke from the forge, and lets out a breath they seem to have been holding for days.*  Thank you.  I mean it.

//: Settle-in line for a recruit who is following you.  It lives on TALK_FRIEND (BN merges same-id talk_topics), not TALK_PSI_AWAKENED: once an NPC is a following ally, BN opens their dialogue on TALK_FRIEND, so responses gated on npc_following in their own chat topic never appear.  The class check keeps it off every other follower.

responses.text: Here we are.  This is the quarry.  Go and find Constance; she'll find you a bunk.

//: Chat topic for anyone the player has brought home (set by npc_first_topic on settling).
dynamic_line: Marcus says I can have the next cabin he builds.  I might cry, honestly.
Theo says I'm sleeping better.  I am.  Nobody's afraid of me here.
Wren's got another pin on the wall.  Better you than me.  ...I mean that kindly.
Constance asked what I could do, and then she just nodded.  Like it was normal.  Like I was normal.

//: Marker: lands on a recruit as they settle in.  mom_hooks.lua's handler drops them from the player's follower list (gapi.remove_npc_follower).  The dialogue effects already moved them to psi_alliance, but no JSON effect clears the follower list without also inventing a lone-wolf faction (talk_function::leave).

dynamic_line: There's always another.  I've marked this one on your map.  Go gently.
